description: Get forward analyst estimates for a company: EPS, revenue, EBITDA and net income (low/high/avg) with analyst counts, for annual or quarterly periods.

limit.description: Maximum number of estimate periods to return (1-40). Defaults to 8.

ticker.description: Company identifier: the current ticker (e.g. "AAPL"), a former ticker of a renamed or delisted company (e.g. "MIGI", now BGDE), or a numeric SEC CIK (e.g. "320193" or "0000320193"). A former ticker or a CIK is answered with a `resolvedFrom` block naming the current symbol.

name: get_analyst_estimates
title: Get Analyst Estimates
